concepts.canonical_he: אין צריכין לעשות שום מלאכה ועסק
concepts.gloss_en: Through charity one need not do any labor or occupation — a benefit of tzedakah (LM2:4)

members.form: אין צריכין לעשׂות שׁום מלאכה ועסק

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are the identical clause from the same sentence in LM2:4 ('אֵין צְרִיכִין לַעֲשׂוֹת שׁוּם מְלָאכָה וְעֵסֶק'); one member is just the shorter truncation of the other, not a distinct concept. Same word, same meaning, same benefit of tzedakah — clear merge.
